name: Search for Incendicite
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear seeks samples of volatile incendicite ore from the Wetlands. He believes its explosive force could change dwarven artillery, and needs miners to reach a secluded cave and bring back the dangerous mineral.

sections.title: A Volatile Discovery
sections.body: Incendicite, a rare and unstable mineral, has drawn the attention of siege engine pilots and mechanics at Steelgrill's Depot. Rich veins are rumored to lie in a cavern northwest of Algaz Gate, in the Wetlands. The ore is highly reactive and dangerous to handle. Careless miners have found it detonating in their faces.

sections.title: Munitions of Tomorrow
sections.body: Pilot Stonegear sees military promise in the dangerous ore. Refined correctly, incendicite could power dwarven artillery or serve as its payload, giving cannon shells force enough to break fortified defenses. Stonegear wants raw samples so researchers can test ways to smelt it without blowing up the depot.

faq.q: What is incendicite ore used for?
faq.answer: Incendicite is an intensely volatile, explosive mineral. Pilot Stonegear wants to test smelting methods that could turn it into powerful artillery ammunition and cannon shells.
The ore lies in a cave system northwest of Algaz Gate, in the southern mountains of the Wetlands.

Pilot Stonegear is a dwarven siege engine pilot with the Ironforge Siege Brigade. He is stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, where he works with mechanics and siege engineers to improve dwarven war machines.

faq.q: Why does harvesting this ore require a pickaxe?
faq.answer: Incendicite lies in raw mineral veins, not loose on the surface. Miners need skill with a pick to chip the brittle, explosive ore from the rock without setting it off.
No. Incendicite is notoriously unstable and may detonate during excavation, transport, or smelting.

faq.q: How does this connect to Stonegear's Search?
faq.answer: This follows 'Stonegear's Search'. Pilot Longbeard or Mountaineer Kadrell sends you to Steelgrill's Depot after Stonegear hears rumors of rare ore and wants someone to find it.

angles.text: As a miner, you need practiced hands to extract incendicite with a pick. Its volatility makes careful work essential.
As a dwarf, you come from a people known for advancing gunpowder and artillery. Incendicite shells fit Khaz Modan's siege traditions.
As an engineer, you know the risk of explosive compounds is part of seeking the next great blast.
